## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run size` pass locally
- [ ] Behaviour changes are covered by a unit test or a simulation
- [ ] Public interfaces (cookie format, admin API, metrics) unchanged, or versioned and documented in `docs/interfaces.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No deployment-specific data (domain, account ID, route, IP, real thresholds)
- [ ] English only; SPDX header on new source files
